positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: I was a Graduate Research Assistant under Professor Hadi Esmaeilzadeh at the University of California, San Diego.

positions.title: Hardware Engineer Intern
positions.description: I designed and implemented software APIs for an acceleration infrastructure for big data analytics platforms.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description: I was a software development engineer intern at Amazon. I designed and implemented a back-end web service for efficient data storage and retrieval for Alexa Smart Home services.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: I was a graduate teaching assistant at Georgia Tech. In Spring 2018, I assisted students enrolled in the graduate-level compiler optimizations course (CS 6241), where students learn both the theory behind various optimization techniques as well as implementation in LLVM. In previous terms (Fall 2017, Spring 2017, Fall 2016), I served as a teaching assistant for the undergraduate algorithms course at Georgia Tech (CS 3510). The course covers fundamental computational problems and algorithmic techniques in computer science. Here is a link to the course website from Fall 2017 semester: https://www.cc.gatech.edu/~rpeng/CS3510_F17/. My primary responsibilities are to hold office hours, prepare and grade homework and test questions, and lead recitation sessions. I enjoy these subjects, and more importantly, helping students understand the course material.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
I was a software development engineer intern on the AWS Aurora Postgres team. I developed a new feature to integrate the AWS IAM (Identity and Authentication Management) service to the existing database user authentication mechanism in Aurora Postgres and RDS Postgres. This greatly simplifies the user authentication process and makes it more secure. It is one of the most wanted features by AWS Aurora Postgres and RDS Postgres customers.

Aurora Postgres is now generally available! Please visit https://aws.amazon.com/rds/aurora/ to get started.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
In our lab, we seek for architectural and cross-stack solutions to improve the performance and energy efficiency of emerging applications. Our solutions typically range from programming languages to architecture design. I have contributed to the development of frameworks to accelerate statistical machine learning algorithms. 

Here is our website: http://act-lab.org/

company.name: Alternative Computing Technologies Lab at Georgia Tech

positions.title: Campus Tour Guide
positions.description: I gave campus tours to perspective students and parents.

positions.title: PLUS Leader (Peer-Led Undergraduate Studies)
positions.description: PLUS is a peer-led tutoring program available to students at Georgia Tech. PLUS leaders hold two voluntary study sessions every week. I helped students enrolled in Calculus II (MATH 1502 at Georgia Tech) understand the course material and prepare for tests and quizzes. I received very positive feedback from my students and was voted for the Outstanding PLUS Leader of the semester.

positions.title: Software Developer Co-op
positions.description: As a software engineering co-op (multiple-term internship program) at Dell SecureWorks, I developed Dell SecureWorks New Generation Customer Portal. This allows Dell SecureWorks customers to view and monitor their security statuses. Through this, I gained hands-on experience on current web development technologies and agile software development process.

honors.title: President's Undergraduate Research Award (PURA)
honors.description:
The President's Undergraduate Research Award (PURA) is a competitive award given to undergraduate students at Georgia Tech who are conducting research with a faculty member. I was awarded the fund for the acceleration of statistical machine learning algorithms project. I received the amount of $1,500.

More information about PURA salary awards can be found here: 
http://urop.gatech.edu/pura-salary
honors.issuer: Issued by Georgia Tech Undergraduate Research Opportunities Program · Aug 2015

honors.description: This is awarded to a new campus tour guide of the semester who showed passion in giving campus tours.
